<!--
A data report is an internal, fully reproducible analysis. Every analysis chunk stays
visible but collapsed, so the document doubles as its own methods appendix.

Note what is NOT in the YAML: `echo: false`. Setting it would silence every chunk and
`code-fold` would do nothing. That single difference is what makes this a data report
rather than a manuscript.
-->

```{r setup}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
source(here::here("R", "0_setup.R"))
source(here::here("R", "report_helpers.R"))
```
